zh-Hans: 试用游戏工程界面，导入文件夹和 ZIP 并检查文件是否完整；试用支持的游戏资源。测试云端语音识别的启动速度，以及回复下的文件修改记录。检查本地运行环境的恢复和提示。
en-US: Try the game project interface, import folders and ZIP files, and check the imported files. Try supported game resources. Test cloud speech recognition startup, file changes shown with replies, and local execution environment recovery and messages.
